question: Does recorded role-memory feedback improve retrieval/retention outcomes beyond the no-feedback baseline?

corpus.rule: Task identities are reused unchanged; this pilot may not author its own task set.

arms.description: Today's behaviour; the flag is off.
Feedback contributes a bounded weight to the retrieval score.

flag.name: runtime.memory.feedbackWeighting.enabled
flag.offState: bit-identical to today's retrieval/retention outputs for the same inputs

budget.note: Null budgets are recorded honestly; a promotion with a null cost dimension is disqualified.

forbidden: changing a product default or product lock
authoring the task set, grader or evidence generator inside the run
claiming benefit from a below-floor sample
limitations: This protocol fixes the question and the bar; it does not run the pilot.
No feedback rows exist in the current checkout, so the first report must be insufficient-evidence.
Feedback is a behavioural signal, not a quality oracle; it can be gamed.
